# 工具类应用特定模板
@router.get("/api/{app_name}/items")
async def get_items():
    """获取项目列表"""
    data = _load(APP_FILE, {"items": []})
    return data

@router.post("/api/{app_name}/items")
async def create_item(req: Request):
    """创建新项目"""
    body = await req.json()
    data = _load(APP_FILE, {"items": []})
    new_item = {{"id": _uid(), "content": body.get("content", ""), "created_at": _now()}}
    data["items"].append(new_item)
    _save(APP_FILE, data)
    return new_item

# 数据分析类应用特定模板
@router.get("/api/{app_name}/data")
async def get_data():
    """获取数据"""
    data = _load(APP_FILE, {"records": [], "stats": {}})
    return data

@router.post("/api/{app_name}/data")
async def add_data(req: Request):
    """添加数据记录"""
    body = await req.json()
    data = _load(APP_FILE, {"records": [], "stats": {}})
    new_record = {{"id": _uid(), "values": body.get("values", {}), "timestamp": _now()}}
    data["records"].append(new_record)
    _save(APP_FILE, data)
    return new_record
